tutorial.info: Deal, trump suit (and the trump card), the stock count, and each player's match / deal score are shown here. Bezique is a 2-player melding trick-taker and the ancestor of Pinochle. The first player to reach the target score (default 1000) wins.
tutorial.trick: Cards played to the current trick appear here. In phase 1 (while the stock remains) you may follow freely, but in phase 2 (after the stock empties) play is strict must-follow. Trumps beat plain cards.
tutorial.hand: This is your hand. During play, click a card and press Play.
tutorial.actions: When you win a trick (phase 1 only) you enter the Meld phase, where you may declare ONE meld — marriage (20), royal marriage (40), Bezique (40), four aces (100), kings (80), queens (60), or jacks (40) — or choose Skip meld. Both players then draw a card. Press Next Deal between deals and games.
